summary: Solo backcountry snowboarder David Heide, 57, of the Saint Mary's area, was caught in an avalanche near Mount Trelease north of Loveland Pass, partially buried-critical, and killed; he was found buried in the debris at Pat's Knob with his airbag inflated.
location: Near Mount Trelease, north of Loveland Pass (Pat's Knob)
notes: CAIC classic 2020-21 season table row: 'Near Mount Trelease, north of Loveland Pass | 1 backcountry snowboarder caught, partially-buried critical, killed'. Victim identified as 57-year-old David Heide of the Saint Mary's area by the Clear Creek Coroner's office (per CPR, 2021-02-15). Run 817 merge: appended incident-specific source URL (parent-opened).
